description: Image Description: The image shows a tiered stand composed of three delicate teacups and saucers stacked vertically. Each cup and saucer set is ornate, featuring a pink and gold color scheme with intricate floral and geometric patterns. The top cup contains a small pink rose with green leaves, adding a decorative touch. The stand is set on what appears to be a white lace tablecloth, contributing to an elegant and vintage aesthetic.
